.. change::
    :tags: bug, environment
    :tickets: 1873

    Fixed issue where a third party plugin published using the
    ``alembic.plugins`` entrypoint, configured to refer to a plugin module as
    documented at :ref:`alembic.plugins.toplevel`, would cause ``import
    alembic`` to fail with a ``TypeError``, as the loaded module was
    erroneously iterated rather than being set up directly. An entrypoint
    that refers to a collection of modules, the form which inadvertently
    worked previously, continues to be accepted but now emits a deprecation
    warning.
